description: Queue a run of a project case with the project's run service and start the service if none is alive. set holds rcfd run --set overrides (path=value). Returns the run id.

continue_from.description: a run id of this project: the run starts from that ended run's output/restart.rcfd

dry_run.description: return what the call would do (case, set, store and run-time plans, the check, memory, whether a runner would start) and write nothing (ADR 0737)

from_run.description: instead of case or new_case: rerun that run id from its case.snapshot with its run.json settings (priority, threads and mem_mb given override them); the new run.json has rerun_of

new_case.description: instead of case: a new case made first, with the arguments of new_case, then run

copy.description: project-relative case file to copy byte for byte

example.description: a shipped example, written byte for byte with the data files it reads

name.description: case name: letters, digits, '-' and '_', at most 64 characters, not taken in cases/ in any letter case; the file is cases/<name>.toml (.json for settings or a .json source)

settings.description: case settings as JSON, written as cases/<name>.json

reason.description: why this change is made, in a short sentence (at most 500 characters): kept with it in the project journal (.rcfd/edits.jsonl), shown in the Studio and by read_feed

run_time.description: set the run's time step: solver.end_time = simulate_s (default the case's), a first step for the courant target (default 0.5) through the thinnest cell, then the solver's Courant controller up to max_dt (default simulate_s/100) (mode adaptive, the default), equal steps (fixed) or the case's own (case); adaptive_correctors (default true) adds solver.corrector_control=adaptive where the solver accepts it. Entries go before the store plan's and set's.

site.description: a site of list_sites with assistant true: the run goes there (its inputs are uploaded, its folder here is kept up to date from the site); any other site is refused before anything is sent

store.description: plan: the Studio's start plan stores the run's fields (about 100 snapshots, f32) unless the case or set gives the store; none: only what the case asks for. Default plan; none is the way back to a run that stores only what its case asks for

name: start_run
